0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak) host the Sacramento Kings (0-6, on a six-game losing streak) in the seventh game of the season for Dallas, with Dallas 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West and Sacramento 15th in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 130-121 home loss on February 26. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Zach LaVine is listed as day-to-day with elbow soreness and is a game-time decision.
